name: beifahrer-extension
description: The beifahrer WebExtension: connects to the local bridge and serves the agent's requests under the per-origin policy the person sets. One source, bundled by gjsify on GJS as MV3 for Chromium and MV2 for Firefox — no Node, no Vite.

scripts.build: gjsify build scripts/build.ts --app gjs --outfile dist/build.gjs.mjs && gjsify run dist/build.gjs.mjs
scripts.zip: gjsify build scripts/build.ts --app gjs --outfile dist/build.gjs.mjs && gjsify run dist/build.gjs.mjs --zip
scripts.dev: gjsify build scripts/build.ts --app gjs --outfile dist/build.gjs.mjs && gjsify build scripts/dev.ts --app gjs --outfile dist/dev.gjs.mjs && gjsify run dist/dev.gjs.mjs
scripts.dev:chromium: gjsify build scripts/build.ts --app gjs --outfile dist/build.gjs.mjs && gjsify build scripts/dev.ts --app gjs --outfile dist/dev.gjs.mjs && gjsify run dist/dev.gjs.mjs --chromium
